criterion: A failed/stop-attempted turn must permit clear same-session recovery.
description: After a Stop attempt the UI displayed a generic failure, and a short follow-up submission did not appear or receive an answer.
expected: A stopped or failed turn should return to a usable composer or explain why a follow-up cannot run, preserving the user's draft when rejected.
actual: Stop was present in a fresh snapshot during the pending long prompt. After activation the UI showed Jory couldn't finish this request. One short follow-up was filled/submitted; the composer cleared but no new bubble/reply appeared. Network metadata includes an initial202 and later409 session POSTs. Cancellation acceptance and cause are unknown.
suggested_fix: Investigate terminal state and409 handling for same-session follow-up; distinguish user cancellation from request failure and preserve rejected input.
